title: Here's 25% off your food
preheader: A bigger voucher for your next visit. Book a table, then show this email at the bar.

data.heading: Hi {{first_name|there}}, here's a bigger one
body: Your last voucher ran out before you had the chance to use it, so here's 25% off your food on your next visit instead.

Sunday's what we live for. Roasts start at 1pm, the kitchen serves until 6pm, and you can arrive up to 5:30pm. There's nothing to order ahead, so you can decide on the day. There are kids roasts too, and the vegan Wellington sits right alongside the beef, pork and turkey.
Walk-ins are always welcome, but book a table to use your voucher.

data.headline: {{voucher_percent}}% off your food
data.how_to_use: Book a table, then show this email at the bar.
conditions: {{voucher_percent}}% off food for the booked table, in one visit.
Not valid with the Christmas menu or special occasion menus.
Cannot be used with any other offer.
Show this email at the bar so we can read the voucher number.

data.body: Pick a day that suits you and book your table. Bring the voucher with you on your phone, and we'll take care of the rest.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked a table with us before. If you would rather not hear from us, you can unsubscribe at any time.
